subject: DeltaFin: follow-up on pen test fixes and compensating controls
messages:
From: Aaron Liu <aaron.liu@deltafin.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security@deltafin.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: post-pen test closure artifacts and controls explanation

Jonas —

Thanks again for the pen test report your team shared last month. Our InfoSec team did a quick pass and asked for a few closure artifacts so we can complete our 3rd-party assessment:

1) A remediation summary mapping the 4 high/critical findings to the tickets and deployments where fixes were applied (screenshots or configuration snippets preferred).
2) Evidence that the API key rotation and scoped key enforcement were applied (logs or console screenshots showing the policy).
3) Tickets or change window IDs for the applied firewall rules and any compensating controls for the ones you couldn't fully remediate.
4) If any findings were mitigated via compensating controls rather than code fixes, a short description and evidence of those controls (IDS/monitoring rules, retention settings, roles).

Can you share the artifacts and a short narrative we can include in our report by EOD Friday PDT? If any of this requires an NDA or redaction, let us know and we can accommodate.

Aaron Liu
Security Engineer, DeltaFin
security@deltafin.com

--
Note: please include the ticket references in your reply so our auditors can cross-check.
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Liu <aaron.liu@deltafin.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: post-pen test closure artifacts and controls explanation

Hi Aaron —

Appreciate the clear list. We can get a closure pack together that includes:
- A one-page mapping (finding -> fix -> ticket id)
- Screenshots of config changes (API key policy page, firewall rule entries)
- Redacted logs showing key rotation events and the associated change window ID
- A short write-up for any compensating controls (IDS rules, enhanced monitoring) and links to the tickets that implement them

We have an internal change ticket set that groups the work. Marissa (cc'd) will assemble the artifacts and export screenshots/config snippets and a short narrative.

Two quick notes: if you require unredacted logs for forensic review we'll need a Data Processing Addendum (we have an existing standard one) — otherwise we will provide redacted logs and signed attestation that they correspond to the listed remediation windows.

Can you confirm: redacted logs + screenshots + ticket links are sufficient for your audit, or do you need the raw logs as well?

I'll aim to get a first packet to you by tomorrow COB PDT; final pack by Friday EOD if that works.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Liu <aaron.liu@deltafin.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: post-pen test closure artifacts and controls explanation

Aaron —

Attached is the initial closure packet. Attachments included as stubs below; full artifacts are in the Drive link at the bottom.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_pt_remediation_summary_20270401.pdf (PDF, 4 pages) — mapping of findings to fixes and ticket IDs (RDW-4589, RDW-4590, RDW-4591, RDW-4592).
- screenshots-configs-20270422.zip (ZIP) — redacted console screenshots showing API key policy change, firewall rule entry, and service role adjustment.
- jira-entries-rdw-4589_to_4592.txt (TXT) — public ticket summaries (no backend logs).

Key points summarized here:
- Finding A (critical): fixed in service version v2.7.1, ticket RDW-4589. Patch applied during maintenance window 2027-03-21T02:00Z. Evidence: screenshot of commit + deployment record in the ticket (see Drive).
- Finding B (high): configuration hardening applied to rate limiter and token validation; ticket RDW-4590. Evidence: console snapshot and a redacted audit entry showing the change.
- Finding C (medium): unable to fully remove deprecated dependency at time of test; mitigated with runtime sandboxing + increased scanning cadence. Ticket RDW-4591. Included: narrative describing compensating control, IDS rule signature ID 6162, and monitoring dashboard screenshot.
- Finding D (high): firewall rule adjustment and IP allowlist enforcement. Ticket RDW-4592. Evidence: firewall rule snapshot + change window ID CW-20270321-11.

We redacted any PII and internal hostnames. If your auditors need raw logs (unredacted), we can provide them under an agreed DPA amendment and temporary access window.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink 

Let us know if you want a packed PDF for your archive — we can produce a single signed PDF with attestation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(attachment stubs included in packet)
From: Aaron Liu <aaron.liu@deltafin.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, security@deltafin.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: post-pen test closure artifacts and controls explanation

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the Drive link. This mostly addresses our needs. A couple of follow-ups from our audit team:

1) Can you provide a simple network segmentation diagram that shows the customer-facing API tier versus internal management plane and where the firewall rules apply? A single-page PNG or PDF is fine.
2) For Finding C (sandboxing compensating control), can you include the IDS rule definition (redacted if needed) and a short note on how you validate the rule's effectiveness (automation / sampling cadence)?

If you can add those two items to the Drive folder by EOD Monday we should be able to close out DeltaFin's 3rd-party assessment.

Aaron

--
Aaron Liu
Security Engineer, DeltaFin
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Liu <aaron.liu@deltafin.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: post-pen test closure artifacts and controls explanation

Aaron —

Thanks — good catches. Marissa will add: 1) single-page network segmentation diagram (PNG) and 2) the IDS rule definition with redactions plus a short validation cadence note (we run automated sampling every 24 hours and an outlier review weekly; included will be a link to the monitoring playbook).

We expect to upload both items to the Drive folder by EOD Monday. If DeltaFin needs a signed attestation for the packet, confirm the name/title for the signatory and we'll prepare it.

Best,
Jonas

Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
